summary: RFC 8141 changed how formal URN namespaces are registered, dropping the old requirement for IETF Consensus. This document handles the transition, so that registrations and rules that depended on the old procedure are updated to fit the new model.

eli5.summary: The old sign-up rules for a type of name were too strict, so they were relaxed. This explains how to move over to the easier rules.

questions: how are urn namespaces registered now
